italian-game.name: Fried Liver Attack
italian-game.description: A deadly knight sacrifice on f7 that wins material and exposes Black's king.

trap_line.explanation: Black tries to block, but it's too late...
Black recaptures, but the knight is vulnerable.
The Fried Liver sacrifice! Knight takes on f7.
Check! Double attack on king and knight on d5.
The king is forced forward into danger.
Develop with tempo. White wins the knight and has a crushing attack.

italian-game.success_message: The Fried Liver Attack! Black's king is exposed and you win material.

italian-game.name: Legal's Mate
italian-game.description: A beautiful queen sacrifice leading to checkmate.

trap_line.explanation: Sacrifice! Offering the queen to set up checkmate.
Black takes the queen, falling into the trap!
Checkmate! The Legal's Mate - a queen sacrifice for mate.

italian-game.success_message: Legal's Mate! A beautiful queen sacrifice leading to checkmate.

italian-game.name: Blackburne Shilling Gambit
italian-game.description: A cunning trap where Black sacrifices a pawn to deliver checkmate!

trap_line.explanation: White grabs the pawn - a natural but losing move!
Threatening Qxg2 and the knight on e5.
White tries to complicate with a fork...
Black ignores the threat and attacks f1!
Check! Picking up the e4 pawn with tempo.
Checkmate! The knight delivers the final blow.

italian-game.success_message: Blackburne Shilling Gambit Mate! A devastating trap for Black.

italian-game.name: Scholar's Mate Defense Trap
italian-game.description: Punish White's premature queen attack and win material!

trap_line.explanation: The knight jumps to a powerful outpost!
Fork! The knight attacks king and rook.
Black wins the exchange - rook for knight!

italian-game.success_message: Scholar's Mate refuted! You won material by exploiting White's greedy play.

italian-game.name: Traxler Counterattack
italian-game.description: Black's daring counter-trap against the Fried Liver setup — if white takes on f7, black launches a king-hunt.

trap_line.explanation: White assumes the Fried Liver sacrifice works — it doesn't.
Knight leaps in with check, winning tempo.
King walks forward — the hunt is on.
Queen joins — white's king has no safe squares.

italian-game.success_message: The Traxler! White's greedy Nxf7 walks into a king-hunt.

italian-game.name: Lolli Variation
italian-game.description: After 4...Nxe4? in the Two Knights, White crashes through with d4 and a kingside attack.

trap_line.explanation: Bishop takes f7 with check — sacrifices for the king hunt.
King is forced to take, now exposed in the open.
White recovers the piece. Black's king is stuck on f7.
Black tries to cover, but the attack is winning.
Knight retreats — White has a piece for two pawns and a crushing attack.

italian-game.success_message: The Lolli Variation — Black's king is dragged out. Big attacking edge for White.

sicilian-defense.name: Siberian Trap
sicilian-defense.description: A deadly trap where Black wins White's queen with a series of checks!

trap_line.explanation: White attacks the knight - a common but losing move!
Black threatens Bxc3+ winning the queen.
White captures, but falls into the trap...
Check! The bishop takes the knight with check.
Take the bishop with another check!
White must take with the queen.
The Siberian Trap! Black wins White's queen.

sicilian-defense.success_message: The Siberian Trap! Black wins White's queen for just a knight.

sicilian-defense.name: Magnus Smith Trap
sicilian-defense.description: A tactical shot that wins material in the Dragon variation.

trap_line.explanation: Devastating! Opening the diagonal to f7.
White wins a pawn and has a strong attack on f7.

sicilian-defense.success_message: The Magnus Smith Trap wins material and opens Black's king!

sicilian-defense.name: Wing Gambit
sicilian-defense.description: White sacrifices a flank pawn early to seize the centre against the Sicilian.

trap_line.explanation: Black accepts the pawn — most natural.
White offers another pawn to clear the b-file and build the centre.
If Black takes, White's d4 and rapid development give big initiative.
Knight develops with tempo, eyeing b5 and c4.
Black tries to hold — but White has open lines and lead in development.

sicilian-defense.success_message: Wing Gambit — pawn for a big centre and quick development against the Sicilian.

queens-gambit.name: Elephant Trap
queens-gambit.description: Black wins a piece with a beautiful intermezzo check!

trap_line.explanation: White thinks they win the queen! But...
Now Black takes back the bishop. You're up a full piece!

queens-gambit.success_message: The Elephant Trap! The intermezzo check wins a piece.

queens-gambit.name: Lasker Trap
queens-gambit.description: A sharp queen trap in the Albin Counter-Gambit!

trap_line.explanation: Underpromotion to knight with check! A rare move.
Check! And the queen falls next move.

queens-gambit.success_message: The Lasker Trap with underpromotion! A sharp queen trap.

queens-gambit.name: Rubinstein Trap
queens-gambit.description: A deep QGD trap where black's careless a6 allows a tactical sequence that wins a pawn through a pin against h7.

trap_line.explanation: Trades center pawns — opens the e-file for white.
Nxd5! Black can't take back — Qxh7 would be mate.

queens-gambit.success_message: The Rubinstein Trap — a careless a6 lets white win a pawn via the h7 pin.

queens-gambit.name: Cambridge Springs Trap
queens-gambit.description: In the QGD Cambridge Springs, if White takes on d5 too greedily, Black wins a piece via a discovered check.

trap_line.explanation: Black recaptures the knight on d5.
White takes the queen — looks winning.
Check! Now the king must move.
Black takes the queen back, gaining a whole piece overall.

queens-gambit.success_message: Cambridge Springs Trap — Black wins a piece using the discovered check on the king.

london-system.name: Englund Gambit Trap
london-system.description: Refute the dubious Englund Gambit and trap Black's queen!

trap_line.explanation: Block the check with the bishop.
Black grabs the pawn greedily, but...
The queen is trapped! No safe squares.
Take the queen! She has nowhere to run.

london-system.success_message: The Englund Gambit refuted! Black's greed costs them the queen.

caro-kann.name: Caro-Kann Smothered Mate
caro-kann.description: A rare smothered mate in the Caro-Kann!

trap_line.explanation: Smothered Mate! The knight delivers checkmate.

caro-kann.success_message: Smothered Mate! Black's pieces block all escape squares.

kings-indian-defense.name: King's Indian Bayonet Trap
kings-indian-defense.description: A tactical sequence in the Bayonet Attack that wins material.

trap_line.explanation: White has a strong passed pawn and attack.

kings-indian-defense.success_message: The Bayonet Attack succeeds! White has a powerful passed pawn.

scandinavian-defense.name: Portuguese Gambit Trap
scandinavian-defense.description: A clever trap where Black gets strong piece activity.

trap_line.explanation: The bishop retreats but maintains the pin.
White develops. Black has good counterplay.

scandinavian-defense.success_message: The Portuguese Gambit leads to active piece play for Black!

ruy-lopez.name: Noah's Ark Trap
ruy-lopez.description: A classic trap that wins White's light-squared bishop!

trap_line.explanation: The Noah's Ark Trap! The bishop is trapped.

ruy-lopez.success_message: Noah's Ark Trap! White's bishop has no escape.

ruy-lopez.name: Mortimer Trap
ruy-lopez.description: A beautiful smothered mate in the Ruy Lopez!
ruy-lopez.success_message: The Mortimer Trap! Smothered mate in the Ruy Lopez.

ruy-lopez.name: Tarrasch Trap (Open Lopez)
ruy-lopez.description: In the Open Ruy Lopez, White exploits the knight on c5 with Re1 — Black loses a piece via a pin.

trap_line.explanation: Black plays the Open Variation — captures the e-pawn.
White takes the bishop on e6.
Queen lines up against the c5 knight.
Black tries to escape — but loses material.

ruy-lopez.success_message: Tarrasch Trap — the c5 knight is pinned and lost. Classic Ruy Lopez trick.

philidor-defense.name: Philidor's Legal Mate
philidor-defense.description: A version of Legal's Mate in the Philidor Defense.

trap_line.explanation: The bishop retreats, maintaining the pin.

philidor-defense.success_message: Legal's Mate in the Philidor! A classic queen sacrifice.

philidor-defense.name: Damiano Defense Punishment
philidor-defense.description: Black plays 2...f6 (the Damiano), inviting a knight sacrifice that exposes the king to forced attack.

trap_line.explanation: Knight takes the pawn — looks risky but it's strong!
If Black takes, the king is exposed.
Check! The king cannot block with a piece.
Forced — Kg6 loses to Qf5+, and pawn moves don't defend.
Wins back the material with continued attack. Black's king is in the open.

philidor-defense.success_message: Damiano Defense Punishment — White recovers material and Black's king is stranded.

petrov-defense.name: Stafford Gambit Trap
petrov-defense.description: A dangerous gambit where Black sacrifices a pawn for a mating attack!
petrov-defense.success_message: Stafford Gambit Mate! A brilliant attacking trap.

petrov-defense.name: Petroff Marshall Trap
petrov-defense.description: The most famous beginner trap in the Petroff — copying white's moves walks into a discovered-check queen grab.

trap_line.explanation: Black 'copies' white but breaks symmetry — correct is d6 first.
The quiet trap move — threatens Nc6+ discovered check.
Black's knight retreats — walking into the discovered check.
Discovered check from the queen — wins the queen on d8.

petrov-defense.success_message: Petroff Marshall Trap — copying moves without checking for discovered attacks costs the queen.

petrov-defense.name: Cochrane Gambit
petrov-defense.description: In the Petrov, White sacrifices the knight on f7 to drag Black's king into the open.

trap_line.explanation: Black must take the knight — but the king is now stuck on f7.
White builds a big centre and opens lines.
Black tries to develop and tuck the king away.
Check! The king has no easy shelter.
Block — forced. White keeps strong attacking chances for the piece.

petrov-defense.success_message: Cochrane Gambit — knight for two pawns and an exposed king. Sharp attacking play.

budapest-gambit.name: Kieninger Trap
budapest-gambit.description: A sharp smothered mate in the Budapest Gambit!

trap_line.explanation: Smothered Mate! The knight delivers checkmate.

budapest-gambit.success_message: The Kieninger Trap! A beautiful smothered mate.

dutch-defense.name: Dutch Defense Mate
dutch-defense.description: A quick checkmate if Black is too aggressive!
dutch-defense.success_message: Dutch Defense Mate! A beautiful queen sacrifice leads to checkmate.

opera-game.name: Opera Game Finale
opera-game.description: The famous finish from Morphy's Opera Game - a model attacking game!

trap_line.explanation: Sacrifice! Opening lines to the king.

opera-game.success_message: The Opera Game! Morphy's immortal attacking masterpiece.

french-defense.name: French Winawer Poisoned Pawn
french-defense.description: White wins material by grabbing pawns while Black's pieces are tangled.

trap_line.explanation: Solid. White is up two pawns with a strong position.

french-defense.success_message: The Poisoned Pawn variation! White wins material.

french-defense.name: French Advance Milner-Barry Gambit
french-defense.description: A sharp gambit where White sacrifices pawns for a strong attack.
french-defense.success_message: The Milner-Barry Gambit leads to a strong attack!

slav-defense.name: Slav Main Line Trap
slav-defense.description: A tactical sequence where Black wins material with a discovered attack.

trap_line.explanation: White tries to build a center.
Knight takes with a discovered attack on the queen!
White tries to save the bishop.

slav-defense.success_message: The Slav Trap wins material with a tactical combination!

nimzo-indian.name: Nimzo-Indian Hubner Trap
nimzo-indian.description: A kingside attack that wins the queen or leads to checkmate.

trap_line.explanation: Check! Winning the queen or mating.

nimzo-indian.success_message: The Hubner Trap leads to a devastating kingside attack!

vienna-game.name: Frankenstein-Dracula Variation
vienna-game.description: A wild gambit with attacking chances for both sides!

trap_line.explanation: The knight is trapped but White has won the exchange.

vienna-game.success_message: The Frankenstein-Dracula leads to wild complications!

queens-indian.name: Queen's Indian Bishop Trap
queens-indian.description: Black wins the light-squared bishop with a clever maneuver.

trap_line.explanation: The bishop dominates! It attacks the rook and controls key squares.

queens-indian.success_message: Black's bishop dominates the light squares!

grunfeld-defense.name: Grunfeld Exchange Trap
grunfeld-defense.description: A pawn storm that gives White a strong passed pawn.

trap_line.explanation: The breakthrough! White gets a strong passed pawn.

grunfeld-defense.success_message: The d5 breakthrough gives White a powerful passed pawn!

benoni-defense.name: Benoni Snake Trap
benoni-defense.description: A central breakthrough that opens lines for White's pieces.
benoni-defense.success_message: The e5 breakthrough opens the position for White's pieces!

blackmar-diemer-gambit.name: Halosar Trap
blackmar-diemer-gambit.description: Classic Blackmar-Diemer Gambit trap — black grabs the d4 pawn and gets punished by rapid development.

trap_line.explanation: Queen retreats to a safe-looking square.
Castles long and threatens Bxa7 + Nb5 ideas.
Black takes the knight to relieve pressure.
Bxa7! Threatens Rxd8+ and Bb7 winning the queen.

blackmar-diemer-gambit.success_message: The Halosar Trap — greed for a pawn costs black the queen.

tennison-gambit.name: Tennison Gambit Trap
tennison-gambit.description: A sharp trap where black's natural h6 walks into a queen sacrifice on f7.

trap_line.explanation: Black tries to kick the knight on g5 — but it's too late.
The real point — bishop delivers check, king must take.

tennison-gambit.success_message: Tennison Trap — h6 looked safe but walked into the Bg6+ queen snatch.

bogo-indian.name: Monticelli Trap
bogo-indian.description: A classic Bogo-Indian trap — black's Ne4 backfires when white plays Ng5 unleashing tactics on the long diagonal.

trap_line.explanation: Not recapturing! Ng5 threatens Bxb7 and Qxh7+.
Black grabs the knight — but now the long diagonal explodes.
Bishop takes — white emerges with extra material.

bogo-indian.success_message: The Monticelli Trap — Ng5 wins material through the long-diagonal geometry.

kings-gambit.name: Kieseritzky Gambit Attack
kings-gambit.description: In the King's Gambit, after the Kieseritzky line, White's central pawns and active pieces produce a crushing attack.

trap_line.explanation: Black tries to develop and put pressure on e4.
Black challenges the knight on e5.
Knight retreats but keeps the position alive.
Black grabs the pawn — but loses to Bxf4 and a strong attack.

kings-gambit.success_message: Kieseritzky Gambit — White sacs a pawn for huge central control and king-side initiative.

scotch.name: Mieses Variation
scotch.description: After 4...Nf6 5.Nxc6, if Black recaptures with the wrong pawn, the position collapses.

trap_line.explanation: Black should recapture with the b-pawn — strong move.
White pushes the pawn, attacking the knight on f6.
Black supports the knight from behind.
White prepares to castle long and continue the attack.
Knight retreats to a strong square — but White has long-term pressure.

scotch.success_message: Mieses Variation — sharp Scotch line where central pawn power dominates.
